relevance_note: The paper describes four individual Japanese Tangier disease patients with ABCA1 variants, e.g. 'He was found to be homozygous for a mutation at G1158A (Ala255Thr) of the ABCA1 gene'.
method_note: Built with a short Python script in the scratch directory; every value was chosen from my reading of the paper, and table spans were cut from the table lines by script and checked to occur verbatim. Tables 1 and 2 show patients as columns; column headers are 'Case 1'..'Case 4' (rule 1 labels), with a 'Normal (n=123)' control column that is out of scope. Contradictions: Table 2 gives Age/Sex '44F' for Case 3 and '74F' for Case 4, while Table 1 gives '44M' and '74M' and the text calls Case 3 'a 44-year-old man' and Case 4 'He'; sex recorded as male from text and Table 1. Case 4 fasting insulin is 4.26 in Table 1 and 4.3 in the text. Case 1 was 48 at first referral (1989) and 54 in Table 1 (no age at onset or diagnosis stated). Cases 3 and 4 were diagnosed in 1985 and 2002 (calendar years only, no age). Variant nucleotide strings (G1158A, C5946T, A3198C) are printed without a c./g. prefix, so cdna_hgvs_as_stated is null and they are kept only in variant_original_string; protein strings are printed without 'p.' and recorded as printed. Case 3: heterozygous Asn935His and 'the other mutation in the ABCA1 gene has not been identified yet' (Table 1 'Asn935His/N.D. ＊', footnote ＊ undefined); no row made for the unidentified second allele. Case 3 'At first he did not have CAD' but later had CABG for 3 coronary arteries; CAD recorded observed (temporal, not a contradiction). Lab values in Table 1 (HDL 6.0/2.5/3.5, triglycerides 395/162/272/42, total cholesterol) are not labelled abnormal per patient by the authors; low HDL checklist is observed only for Case 1 ('very low HDL cholesterol'); 'triglycerides were increased in two TD patients' names no one, so hypertriglyceridemia is not reported for all. The text list 'FPG level was elevated 163, 180, 180 and 176' was not assigned by position; elevated FPG/fasting hyperglycemia is taken from the group statement about all TD patients in the study. Foamy macrophages in the gastric mucosa (Cases 3, 4) recorded as features but not mapped to the checklist item 'intestinal mucosal lipid deposits' (gastric, not intestinal). Group statements naming all four patients ('all 4 TD patients suffered from diabetes mellitus', 'all 4 subjects ... an absence of insulin resistance', 'Serum total cholesterol was decreased in all TD patients') used with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. Table 1 '(＋)'/'(-)' symbols in the Coronary artery disease row are undefined in a legend; CAD status relies on text statements, with the table cell as a supporting span. Prior reports: Case 1 also carries citations '3, 6, 7)' and '7)', Case 2 '6, 7)', Case 3 '8)', Case 4 '9)'; source_reference_in_review left 'not reported' because the patients are described first-hand. Study type recorded as 'case report' from the section heading, although it describes four patients plus 123 controls.
